body.x: WiTricity(witricity.com), a provider of foundational technology to enable wireless power transfer over distance using magnetic resonance, demonstrated "Rezence-enabled Solutions" at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.WiTricity showcases its Rezence capabilities across a range of applications, giving attendees the chance to experience wireless charging in person, as well as offering demonstrations for automotive and a range of cutting-edge applications. Its demo will include a Rezence-ready wireless charging hotspot where attendees can power up their devices remotely.As Witricity's recent announcement of the A4WP Partner Program, it easier for organizations to incorporate WiTricity’s patented wireless power technology into products and solutions designed for the A4WP Rezence specification, a wireless power transfer technology. WiTricity also recently announced the WiT-5000C3 development kit, the first in a series of reference design kits for companies looking to kick-start the creation of A4WP Rezence-ready devices.“This CES will kick off the year of wireless power, and we expect Rezence to dominate the conversation” said Alex Gruzen, WiTricity CEO.Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), CES 2015 is the world's largest IT and consumer electronics exhibition to see the latest global trends in consumer electronics industry in one spot.Globally recognized for its record in the number of published articles for CES, AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES every year to deliver the fastest and freshest news on the spot.
